title: KM VMS 0.7.29 — Compact Update Confirmation Dofix
summary: Replaces the oversized update dialog with a compact application confirmation and keeps launch errors localized on the existing Maintenance surface.
changelog: Uses the same compact confirmation pattern as other Settings actions, with only the question and Cancel/Update buttons.
Keeps version, release and commit details on the existing Maintenance surface instead of duplicating them in the confirmation.
Closes the confirmation immediately after submission and leaves launch reconciliation on the existing update panel.
Maps known admission failures to localized operator text instead of displaying raw backend responses.
Registers 0.7.28 as the immediate trusted predecessor for the 0.7.29 release.
Keeps update trust, admission, polling, database schema, service topology, retention and Stage 6.6.1 boundaries unchanged.
